kr-workbook-reg-0596-clean-air-conservat.summary: Reference record for Korea's motor vehicle emissions certification and permissible emission standards under the Clean Air Conservation Act, covering exhaust and evaporative emission limits and on-board diagnostics for vehicles manufactured or imported into Korea. This repository does not hold the Korean legal text.
kr-workbook-reg-0596-clean-air-conservat._why: Old summary asserted fuel economy/CO2 specifics not backed by cited provisions and was truncated

kr-workbook-reg-0597-noise-and-vibration._why: Body is noise-only (Regulated Area: Noise / sound)

kr-workbook-reg-0599-act-on-resource-cir.summary: Reference record for Korea's Act on Resource Circulation of Electrical and Electronic Equipment and Vehicles, which addresses recycling and end-of-life treatment of vehicles sold in Korea. This repository does not hold the Act's text, so specific obligations are not summarised.
